_comment: ✏️ Gelato print-on-demand settings. Per-item settings (which Gelato product, auto-fulfil on/off) live on each work in works.json / each item in shop-items.json.
_instructions: You rarely need to touch this. shipmentMethodUid blank = let Gelato pick the cheapest option that reaches the buyer.
_safety_comment: Guards on AUTOMATIC fulfilment only. If a burst of orders arrives, or one looks unusual, the order is created as a Gelato DRAFT (nothing prints) and you get an email to review it. Approve drafts with: npm run gelato -- --drafts   then   npm run gelato -- --approve all --live
